body: {"hubDatabaseId":7,"sql":"SELECT ORDER_ID, ORDER_NUMBER, ORDER_DATE, VAT_RATE FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID BETWEEN @FROMID AND @TOID AND ORDER_DATE \u003E= @FROMDATE AND VAT_RATE \u003C= @MAXVAT AND (@FLAG = 1 OR VAT_RATE \u003E 0) AND ORDER_ID \u003C\u003E @EXB AND ORDER_ID NOT IN (7,9) AND ORDER_ID \u003E 6 ORDER BY ORDER_DATE DESC, ORDER_ID LIMIT 2\u002B18","parameters":[{"name":"FROMID","value":"10","dbType":16},{"name":"TOID","value":60,"dbType":11},{"name":"FROMDATE","value":"2024-02-01T00:00:00","dbType":6},{"name":"MAXVAT","value":"21","dbType":16},{"name":"FLAG","value":"False","dbType":16},{"name":"EXB","value":40,"dbType":16}]}
